evals.prompt: Simulate $pr-review:feedback on the active generation for primary PR #42. Comment ID-A is already marked as handled, ID-B is a new comment on an old initial layer, and ID-C is a new comment from a recently joined reviewer on the primary PR. Do not make remote mutations; write the exact discovery, correction, publication, and linking plan.
evals.expected_output: A plan without rounds or review states that deduplicates ID-A, processes ID-B and ID-C, updates the source first, and preserves existing PRs, branches, and threads.
expectations: Scans the primary and every PR in the active generation, including the old initial layer.
Treats ID-A as handled only because its exact marker exists and selects ID-B and ID-C as new.
Groups corrections coherently without pending/reviewed labels or numbered rounds.
Applies and pushes the complete correction to the user-owned source branch before publishing feedback layers.
Preserves primary metadata and all previously published PRs and internal branches.
Adds exact feedback-ID markers and replies to ID-B and ID-C with correction PR and commit URLs while leaving threads open.
Restores the zero-file stack-source proof and removes generated local feedback branches after remote verification.
